subject: Legends for separate lines and points

messages.author: 8a178e049e2c95d3
messages.subject: Legends for separate lines and points
parts:
I am relatively new to ggplot2 and I don't seem to be able to find an answer to how you create a legend if you plot two different y values in a plot.
Here is some example code similar to what I am trying to do
library(ggplot2)

x <- rep(runif(20),5)
y <- rnorm(100)
y2 <- mean(y) + sd(y)*x
treat <- ifelse(x > 0.5, "treat 1","treat 2")
crop <- ifelse(y > 0,"Fallow","Crop")

plot.frame <- data.frame(x = x, y = y, y2 = y2, treat = treat,
      crop = crop)
     
p <- ggplot(plot.frame, aes(x=x,y=y)) +
      geom_point(size=2,colour="black") +
      geom_line(aes(x=x,y=y2,colour="red"),colour="red",size=1) +
      facet_grid(crop~treat) +
      opts(labels = c(x = "Variable 1", y = "Variable 2"))

print(p)


I would like to have a legend next to the plot that says:
Legend title
"Points name"
"Line name"

I have searched through all the posts, but have not managed to figure it out. Any help is appreciated.
Regards
Willem

Unfortunately the legend can't currently tell you only have red points
and black lines, but it's something I hope to fix in a future release.

Hadley
